recipes.name: 10 Levels Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 whole rotisserie chicken (or ~3 lbs mixed chicken parts)
instructions: For Level 6: No Prep Chicken Noodle Soup:
For the For the Servings: 4–6
For the Estimated Time: 15 minutes
Bring water and chicken base to a boil. - 4 cups water - 4 tsp chicken base
Add vegetables and simmer briefly. - 2 cups frozen vegetable mix
Add chicken and noodles. - 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken - 2 cups egg noodles
Cook until noodles are tender.
Season and serve.
For Level 7: Simple From-Scratch:
For the Stock
For the For the Servings 4-6
For the Estimated Time 45 minutes

Halve garlic bulb, then roughly chop Spanish onion, celery, and carrots. Optionally peel the carrots. - 1 large garlic bulb halved - 1 large Spanish onion skinned - 4 celery inner stalks and leaves - 4 carrots optionally peeled
Peel and roughly chop the parsnip. - 1 parsnip optional
Then, shred the whole rotisserie chicken. - 1 whole rotisserie chicken (or ~3 lbs mixed chicken parts)

Add chopped vegetables to a stockpot with shredded rotisserie chicken. Add peppercorns and fresh parsley. Add water to cover, then cover with a lid. - 1 tbsp whole black peppercorns - 1 bunch parsley (stems and leaves separated) - water to cover
Bring to a gentle simmer and skim fat from the top of the stock. Once it reaches a gentle simmer, partially cover.
Maintain low heat (~180–190°F) and cook for 3–12 hours.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve and discard solids.
For the Soup Base
Uniformly dice onion, celery stalks, and carrots. - 1 large onion diced - 4 celery stalks diced - 4 carrots peeled and diced
Then add about a tablespoon of olive oil to a sauté pan over medium heat. Add the diced vegetables to the pan and sweat for 3-5 minutes until just softened. - olive oil as needed
Add the homemade stock and bring it up to a bare simmer.
Kill the heat, then add the boneless, skinless chicken thighs to the hot soup. Cover and let the residual heat par-cook the vegetables and chicken. - 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
Transfer soup (without noodles) to a container and refrigerate overnight.
.For the Assembly
Reheat soup in a saucepan.
Stir in chopped parsley leaves and fresh dill. - fresh dill to taste
Add egg noodles and cook until tender (~8–10 minutes). - egg noodles
Season with kosher salt to taste and serve hot! - kosher salt to taste
For Level 8: Matzo Ball Soup:
For the For the Servings: 4–6
For the Estimated Time 60-90 minutes
For the Matzo Balls
In a mixing bowl, combine box matzo mix, eggs, and oil.
Add garlic powder, onion powder, chopped parsley, and chopped dill.
Mix until fully combined.
Let mixture rest for 20 minutes.
Wet hands with water then roll dough into balls about the size of a ping pong ball.
For the Assembly
Bring prepared chicken soup (from Level 6 or 7) to a simmer.
Add matzo balls.
Cover and simmer for 20–45 minutes until puffed and cooked through.
For the For the Serving
Place matzo balls in bowls.
Ladle soup over top.
Garnish with additional chopped parsley and dill.
For Level 9: Avgolemono (Greek Lemon Chicken Soup):
For the Servings 4
For the Estimated Time 45 minutes
For the Soup Base
Bring prepared chicken soup to a gentle simmer. - prepared chicken soup
Add ¾ cup orzo pasta and cook until tender. - ¾ cup orzo pasta
For the Egg-Lemon Mixture
In a bowl, whisk together 1 whole egg, 2 egg yolks, juice of 2 lemons, and 1 finely grated garlic clove until smooth. - 1 large egg - 2 egg yolks - 2 juice of lemons - 1 garlic clove
For Tempering
Slowly ladle hot soup into the egg mixture while whisking constantly.
Continue until mixture is warm and loosened.
For Finishing
Reduce soup heat to low.
Slowly pour egg mixture back into soup while stirring constantly.
Cook gently until slightly thickened (do not boil).
For Serving
Stir in 2 tbsp chopped parsley and 1 tbsp chopped dill. - 2 tbsp fresh parsley chopped - 1 tbsp fresh dill chopped
Season with kosher salt and black pepper. - kosher salt - freshly ground black pepper
Serve immediately.
For Level 10: Fine Dining Chicken Noodle Soup:
For the Servings 6
For the Estimated Time 3-4 hours
For the Stock
Thinly slice onion, carrots, celery stalks, parsnip, and garlic cloves. - 2 onions - 4 carrots - 4 celery stalks - 1 parsnip - 4 garlic cloves
Render fat from pieces of the chicken in a pressure cooker. - 1 whole high quality chicken
Add sliced vegetables and sauté lightly.
Add remaining chicken pieces and cover with water.
Pressure cook for 75 minutes and allow natural release.
For Clarifying the Broth
Freeze the finished stock completely.
Place frozen stock in a coffee filter or cheesecloth.
Allow to slowly thaw into a clear consommé.
For the Chicken
Season chicken breasts lightly with salt. - 2 chicken breasts - pinch kosher salt
Vacuum seal (optional).
Cook at 140°F for 1–1.5 hours.
Cut into small uniform cubes.
For the Pasta
Combine breadcrumbs, semolina flour, parmesan, and a pinch of salt. - 1 cup breadcrumbs - 1 cup semolina flour - ½ cup grated parmesan cheese
Add eggs and mix into a dough. - 2 eggs
Adjust with flour until slightly dry and crumbly.
Extrude or shape into small noodles.
Cook in boiling water for ~45 seconds.
For the Vegetables
Finely dice carrots, celery stalks, parsnip, and turnip into small uniform cubes. - 1 turnip
Blanch in boiling water for 1–3 minutes.
Transfer immediately to an ice bath.
For the Infused Schmaltz
Heat chicken fat over low heat. - 1 cup rendered chicken fat

Add cinnamon stick, star anise, clove, cardamom pods, coriander seeds, and a pinch saffron. - 1 cinnamon stick - 1 star anise pod - 1 whole clove - 3 cardamom pods - 1 tsp coriander seeds - pinch saffron
Simmer gently for ~5 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil (optional) and strain. - 1 tsp sesame oil (optional)
For the Assembly
Arrange diced vegetables and chicken cubes in serving bowls.
Add cooked pasta.
Add fresh dill and parsley. - fresh dill - fresh parsley
Heat consommé with lemongrass, ginger, lemon peel, parsley, and white peppercorns. - lemongrass - fresh ginger - lemon peel - white peppercorns
Strain and pour hot broth over bowl.
Drizzle infused schmaltz on top.
Finish with salt and pepper.
